name: Haus Tyrol
beschreibung: The Haus Tyrol is located in the sunny village area of Gerlos in the Zillertal, framed by the majestic backdrop of the Zillertal Alps. These welcoming holiday apartments offer abundant space for couples and families seeking an independent alpine getaway. Amenities include fully fitted kitchenettes with dining space, comfortable bedrooms and lounges, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and private balconies presenting splendid views of the surrounding three-thousand-metre summits. A ski room with boot dryers and on-site parking add to the convenience. The valley station of the Dorfbahn Gerlos cable car, offering immediate access into the extensive Zillertal Arena ski expanses, is only a short walk away. Summer delivers mountain biking, high trails, and watersports at the Durlassboden reservoir.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy holiday apartments in Gerlos in the Zillertal with fully fitted kitchens, balconies, and just a short walk to the Dorfbahn.
